purpose: Deterministic 30-day campaign matrix and release-profile contract for the post-cutover leader AI.
seedFormula: seed = seedStart + index for 0 <= index < seedCount

sets.description: New colony with no prebuilt late-game support.
Stable village with core food, water, storage, and Hole access.
Late-midgame village with scholars, research frontier, boosts, diplomacy, and trade.
Low food, water, storage, worker, route, and replacement-resource margins.
Highly Devout leadership pressure with endless Hole demand.
Highly Skeptical leadership pressure with delayed or omitted Hole work.
Highly Mercantile valuation pressure and trade preference.
Highly Self-sufficient valuation pressure and trade avoidance.
Highly Bold risk posture under hazards, injuries, and route pressure.
Highly Cautious risk posture under hazards, injuries, and route pressure.
Injury, treatment, refusal, prosthetic fitting, repair, and cargo conservation pressure.
Multiple villages with isolated private state and public diplomacy/trade facts.
Cross-colony and intra-colony reservations contending for source, route, endpoint, cargo, tools, and workers.
Belief-driven Hole choices including good packages, stale poor packages, omission, and replacement work.
Affordable frontier, seven-day free Leader quota, no carryover, Research Notes, physical preparation, and Void-funded God-lane pressure.
Consent, alliance/block, valuation, escrow, route, cargo, recovery, and stable trade ordering.
Restart at active Hole, Void Insight, Research Notes, boost, task, injury, prosthetic, diplomacy, trade, and route stages plus tick partition twins.
